Removes one or more references from a source object.

Can remove specific target IDs across reference fields, remove all references of
a specific kind

using --kind, or clear all references on the object using --all.

  Remove specific requirement from backlog item
  zqk object ref remove BLI-001 REQ-001
  Remove all criteria references
  zqk object ref remove REQ-001 --kind criteria
  Purge all references on an object
  zqk object ref remove BLI-001 --all

Usage:
  zqk object ref remove [flags]

Flags:
      --all                     Remove all references across all reference fields on the object
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --field string            Restrict removal to a specific reference field
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --kind string             Remove all references pointing to objects of this kind
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
      --park                    Park parent execution plan (transition to paused) if remaining items reach zero instead of auto-completing
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
